Delhi High Court to hear habeas corpus plea over arrest

The Delhi High Court is scheduled to hear a habeas corpus petition filed by Swatantra Bhardwaj concerning his arrest. The petition challenges the legality of Bhardwaj's detention. The court will examine the circumstances of his arrest and the basis for his continued custody. The hearing is expected to address whether Bhardwaj's rights have been violated by his detention.
